svg.title: 03a · Infrastructure Architecture: As-Is
svg.desc: Left: a single Docker host with the mojaloop-net network, switch services, data stores, simulated FSPs, optional profiles and the separate monitoring project, with published ports, measured resources and missing persistence. Right: evidence of an external Kubernetes cluster (namespaces mojaloop, stateful-resources, argocd, redpanda; Istio gateway; Helm release moja) and the items not present in the repository.
svg.text: What the repository actually deploys (Docker Compose on one host) and what its Kubernetes files reveal about the cluster they were written for
docker-compose.yml + profiles · tested on Windows 11, Docker Desktop (WSL2), Compose v5.6.1
CircleCI · mojaloop/build orb on release tags
Fails on Docker Desktop for Windows
one flat bridge network · Docker DNS by container name
1 replica each · no restart policy · run as root
No named volumes: data lives in container storage
mojaloop-testing-toolkit (+ UI) · ttk-provisioning / ttk-tests CLI jobs
payerfsp-, payeefsp-, testfsp1..4-sdk, each with its own Redis
fx: FX SDKs and FX provisioning/tests
config-modifier merges configs/*.js into the image's default.json → wait4 waits for dependencies (60 × 10 s) → npm run migrate (where needed) → start.
Compose health checks: 17 (central-settlement's uses the wrong port).
Every handler is its own container with a replica variable (QS_REPLICAS, ALS_REPLICAS, CENTRAL_LEDGER_*_REPLICAS, ML_*_REPLICAS, all 1
in .env), separate mysql-cl, 8 simulated FSPs, ISO 20022 mode, 25 partitions for position topics.
Published host ports (everything else is internal)
TTK 9440 / 9550 / 9660 · MongoDB 27017 · Redis 6379, 6381–6391 · finance portal 9400, 9401, 9302, 9304, 8082 · Kafka UI 8080 (debug) · switch
Standard stack: 31 services, ~4.5 GiB · finance-portal stack: 37
No requests, limits or reservations in any compose or Kubernetes file
on-premises bare metal (*.devbaremetal.moja-onprem.net) · not deployed by this repo
ConfigMap config-override mounted as .CLEDGrc, .MLAPIrc, .QUOTErc, .EVENT_SDKrc · init container run-migration
Event SDK sidecar toggle (EVENT_SDK_SIDECAR_DISABLED) · ledger service scaled to 8 replicas by patch.sh schema
ArgoCD Application redpanda-app (Helm chart from charts.redpanda.com, automated prune + self-heal)
TTK jobs moja-ml-ttk-test-setup and moja-ml-ttk-test-val-gp run as PostSync hooks · secretRef …-aws-creds
Redpanda Console (Kafka UI) installed by patch.sh init
Dockerfile builds a k6-operator runner image with packages/k6-tests; config-k8s/ holds 36 Kubernetes scenario configs
Not in this repository (shown nowhere as existing)
Helm charts and values · node pools and control-plane layout · StorageClasses and PersistentVolumes · NetworkPolicies · HPA / VPA ·
PodDisruptionBudgets · CPU and memory requests or limits · ingress for the FSPIOP APIs · secrets definitions
Kubernetes facts come only from k8s-mojaloop-perf-tuning/ and packages/k6-tests/config-k8s/. The production design is in 03b.
